raw_segments.text: I tell you I could not forget it, and I took my revenge, for you to be adopted by your
uncle and placed in a state of ease and comfort was what I could not endure.
I said I was sorry for his disappointment, but Jane Eyre was dead.
She had died of typhus fever at load.
Now act as you please, write and contradict my assertion, expose my falsehood as soon
You were born, I think, to be my torment.
My last hour is racked by the recollection of a deed which, but for you, I should never
